name: MMEdit
description: MMEdit is a benchmark for editing multimodal large language models, providing a dataset and a suite of innovative metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of model editing techniques on multimodal LLMs.
reputation: A specialized benchmark used in the multimodal model-editing literature, but not yet a broadly adopted general-purpose benchmark.
notes: Focuses on the challenging task of editing multimodal LLMs; includes analysis of editing different model components.
